description: Defines Swagger API documentation classes for provisioning criteria management in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for CRUD operations.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger API schemas for provisioning criteria operations.

classes.name: PostProvisioningCriteriaRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating new provisioning criteria, including name, associated loan products, and provisioning criteria definitions.

classes.name: PostProvisioningCriteriaResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating provisioning criteria, primarily returning resource ID.

classes.name: GetProvisioningCriteriaResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving provisioning criteria details by ID, including name and creator.

classes.name: GetProvisioningCriteriaCriteriaIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for detailed provisioning criteria including associated loan products and definitions.

classes.name: PutProvisioningCriteriaRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating provisioning criteria, similar to creation schema.

classes.name: PutProvisioningCriteriaResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating provisioning criteria, including resource ID and change details.

classes.name: DeleteProvisioningCriteriaResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting provisioning criteria, primarily resource ID.
